source.kind: official Kaggle CLI full leaderboard export

method.arithmetic: Exact Decimal comparison of displayed scores; no floating-point tolerance.
method.position: 1 + number of reference teams with strictly better displayed score. Tied-position interval ends at better + max(equal, 1).
method.top_percent: 100 * score_equivalent_best_position / reference_teams; smaller is better. This rank-based descriptor can exceed 100 for a hypothetical score below every reference score.
method.percentile: 100 * strictly_worse / reference_teams; higher is better. Tied reference teams are excluded; weak percentile including ties is also retained.
method.denominator: Unique scored teams present in this dated public export, not an assumed historical registration count.
method.scope: Score-equivalent comparison with the downloaded public reference population. It is not an awarded final competition rank or percentile of late entrants. Public scores are compared only with public leaderboard scores.

limitations: The export contains the public leaderboard only. Private leaderboard percentiles are not inferred.
Displayed scores are rounded; tie counts and positions use exactly those rounded values.
Snapshots may omit deleted or otherwise unavailable historical teams and may differ from the competition-era participant count.
Internal OOF/holdout metrics have different populations and are never mapped to leaderboard percentiles.
Account-best leaderboard positions can come from other submissions; score context does not establish that the preserved source produced the account-best result.

scores.label: Modern DeBERTa + fixed rounding, one-shot late submission
